summary_transfer: Shinkansen to Kyoto on the morning of 19 May (already booked).

arrival.title: Arrival
items: Sample Pacific SP104 lands at Haneda mid-afternoon on 15 May.
Train or taxi to Shibuya; rooms may not be ready until 15:00 — the lobby will hold bags.
Issue an IC card at the airport or the first station for metro rides.

food_notes.title: Food
items: The party's combined restriction is vegetarian. Places below were judged against that union.
Many ramen shops use pork or fish broth — Midori Bowl is listed because this sample uses a vegetable broth. Always re-ask on the day.

notes: This entire destination is fictional and for documentation only.
